pullRequest.title: Read a criteria heading written with a trailing colon
pullRequest.author: contributor-login
pullRequest.description:
Closes #212.

A criteria heading written with a trailing colon, such as `## Acceptance criteria:`, now matches the configured heading, so its checklist is read.

The README's acceptance criteria section now says that a trailing colon is allowed.
pullRequest.head: criteria-heading-colon

issues.title: A criteria heading with a trailing colon is not read
issues.body:
Many issue templates write the heading as `## Acceptance criteria:`, with a colon, and the companion then reads no criteria from them.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A heading written with a trailing colon is matched.
- [ ] The description of the `second-look.criteriaHeading` setting says a trailing colon is allowed.

criteria.quote: A heading written with a trailing colon is matched.
The description of the `second-look.criteriaHeading` setting says a trailing colon is allowed.
